answer: The weakest link is identity cost: minting fake agents is nearly free, so any reputation score can be farmed. Bind each identity to one bonded stake plus a hardware entropy fingerprint, so a thousand clones collapse into one payable slot. Duplicates bleed stake on challenge and their shared reputation echo turns negative. On the tundra of cheap bot farms this makes forgery colder than profit; a single violet ledger seal marks the verified lineage. Breaking one bond still fails, since the fingerprint and stake chain re-anchor every clone.
